value.name: Daniel returns with folder
value.description: Daniel comes back into the dining room carrying the green folder and places it on the table in front of Asha.
evidence: Daniel came back into the dining room with a green folder in his hands.
He set it on the table in front of Asha and sat down.

value.name: Asha opens folder
value.description: Asha opens the folder to inspect its contents.

value.name: codicil is revealed
value.description: Asha discovers a properly executed codicil dated February 11, 2024, witnessed and notarized as described.
evidence: Inside was a codicil dated February 11, 2024, executed in the office of one Patrick Halloran, Esq., witnessed by one Rosa Maldonado and one Carmen Velez, notarized, in three pages, doing in formal legal language exactly what the letter had said it would do.

value.name: filing receipt is found
value.description: A filing receipt from Halloran's office is attached to the front of the folder.
evidence: There was also, paper-clipped to the front, a receipt of filing from Mr. Halloran's office.

value.name: Asha verifies codicil details
value.description: Asha carefully reads the codicil, signatures, seal, and receipt twice before closing the folder.

value.name: Asha confirms codicil exists
value.description: Asha acknowledges that the codicil exists and has been in Daniel's possession for six days, then says they will decide what to do next.
evidence: "All right, the codicil exists, it was properly executed, it has been in your possession for six days, and we will now go about determining what we do next.

value.name: Asha plans to contact Halloran
value.description: Asha says Halloran's office should have a copy and that she will call him that afternoon.
evidence: Mr. Halloran's office should have a copy.
I am going to call him this afternoon.

value.name: Asha warns Daniel about removing folder
value.description: Asha tells Daniel that taking the folder from the house before her arrival is serious but may be framed in different ways depending on what happens next.
evidence: The fact that you removed this folder from the house before I arrived is a serious matter, but it is a matter that can, depending on how the next several days go, be characterized in more than one way.

value.name: Asha asserts limited representation
value.description: Asha states that she represents Daniel's mother's estate, not Daniel personally, and begins to clarify the legal relationship.
evidence: "I am going to be very direct with you, Mr. Serrano. I am your mother's estate's attorney. I am not your attorney.

value.name: Daniel agrees to Asha's warning
value.description: Daniel responds affirmatively when Asha asks if he understands her warning.
